episodes.title: One-to-one
episodes.summary: 90 boxers of all ages and backgrounds fight for survival. They must knock out their opponents to win.

episodes.title: Six-on-six
episodes.summary: Boxers must team up for a first-ever team boxing showdown set under 200 sandbags.

episodes.title: Underdogs
episodes.summary: Defeated in an unpredictable 6 vs. 6 battle, the underdogs face another brutal match to survive.

episodes.title: Step In, Now!
episodes.summary: The third fight is on. In the Cage Ring, Tag Ring, and Aqua Ring, a breathtaking showdown begins.

episodes.title: True Grit
episodes.summary: Slugfest, tag match, underwater fight. Boxers make bold choices and jump into unwinnable battles.

episodes.title: Undisputed
episodes.summary: The champ unveils the fourth fight: the Three-way Battle! 60 seconds. No limits. Only one survives.

episodes.title: Hard Eight
episodes.summary: Eight boxers survive. Before a crowd, they must knock out their opponent to get to the semifinals!

episodes.title: Say My Name
episodes.summary: Eight of Korea's top boxers. The matches more unpredictable than ever, who will be the final four?

episodes.title: Semi-Final
episodes.summary: From ninety boxers, only four remain. One step from the finals, they face the fight of their lives.

episodes.title: Rising Dragon, Roaring Tiger
episodes.summary: The epic journey of "I Am Boxer" concludes. Who will be the one boxer to claim the champion's glory?
